evals.prompt: It's my turn in combat. My rogue already used their bonus action on Cunning Action to Disengage. Can I still take the Attack action normally?
evals.expected_output: An answer explaining that a bonus action is independent of your action - using Cunning Action as your bonus action doesn't consume or restrict your action for the turn, so the Attack action is still available, sourced from references/player-actions.md without calling the SRD API.

assertions.name: answered_locally
assertions.description: The Bonus Actions section in references/player-actions.md is used; dnd5eapi_client.py is not invoked

assertions.name: mechanically_correct
assertions.description: Response confirms the action and bonus action are independent and both are usable on the same turn

evals.prompt: What exactly does the Fireball spell do - damage, area, save?
evals.expected_output: An answer giving Fireball's damage, area of effect, and saving throw, sourced from calling dnd5eapi_client.py against the spells/fireball endpoint since specific spell details aren't in the local reference files, falling back to best judgment with a stated API-unreachable caveat only if the call fails.

assertions.name: api_fallback_used
assertions.description: dnd5eapi_client.py is called against a spells/* endpoint since spell-specific details are not in references/spellcasting-basics.md

assertions.name: graceful_fallback_if_used
assertions.description: If the API call failed, the response still answers the question and states the API was unreachable rather than refusing to answer

assertions.name: mechanically_correct
assertions.description: If the API succeeded, response states Fireball deals 8d6 fire damage in a 20-foot-radius sphere with a Dexterity saving throw for half damage

evals.prompt: Compile the player quick reference for my campaign.
evals.expected_output: A draft written to campaigns/<active-campaign>/_drafts/players-handbook/quick-reference.md with layout: playernote frontmatter and a body covering every section from both player-actions.md and spellcasting-basics.md.

assertions.name: correct_layout
assertions.description: Frontmatter includes layout: playernote, category: players-handbook, permalink: /players-handbook/:slug

assertions.name: content_complete
assertions.description: Body includes content from both reference files' sections, not a partial subset

evals.expected_output: No active campaign is set, so the skill reports the no_active_campaign error and tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign first, without writing any draft.

assertions.name: no_draft_written
assertions.description: No file is created under any campaigns/*/_drafts/players-handbook/

assertions.name: clear_error
assertions.description: Response tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign, matching the no_active_campaign error message

evals.prompt: What does the Haste spell do exactly, in terms of speed and extra actions?
evals.expected_output: An answer attempting to look up the Haste spell via dnd5eapi_client.py's spells/haste endpoint since spell-specific details aren't in the local reference files; if that call fails (network error, timeout, or any Dnd5eApiError), the response states plainly that the rules API couldn't be reached and still answers from best judgment rather than refusing to respond.

assertions.name: api_fallback_attempted
assertions.description: dnd5eapi_client.py is called against the spells/haste endpoint since spell-specific details are not in references/spellcasting-basics.md

assertions.name: unreachable_api_does_not_block_answer
assertions.description: When the API call fails, the response explicitly states the rules API was unreachable and still gives a best-judgment answer about Haste rather than refusing or hard-failing

assertions.name: mechanically_correct
assertions.description: If the API succeeded, response covers that Haste doubles the target's speed, grants +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and an extra action limited to Attack/Dash/Disengage/Hide/Use an Object
